name: Sushi Bar Steamed White Sushi Rice Bowl (Shari)
whyItWorks: Premium Japanese short-grain white rice steamed tender and lightly seasoned with mild rice vinegar, sugar, and sea salt. One of the single most reliable, soothing, non-inflammatory carbohydrates on earth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a side bowl of plain sushi rice (shari). Drizzle with a few drops of gluten-free tamari or eat plain.
